notes.title: Cosmic Holidays pre-prod. #1: a quick look at our universe ! 👽
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/692389701411274883/1111251206455697448/couverture_poste_steam04.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Hello, everyone ![/b][/h3]

Some visual of our [u]cosmic holidays[/u] game for you.

We are [u]still in pre-production[/u] but [b]we look forward to sharing[/b] with you more content.

Our game is mainly made in 2D. However, for animation and production reasons, [u]we chose to manage all the characters in 3D[/u]. It's a question here of finding a visual balance between 2D and 3D. We are happy with the result, what do you think?

[previewyoutube=GtxdtrmrfXE;full][/previewyoutube]

With love,
The I am a dog Team
